episodes.title: Are You Happy in Your Life?
episodes.summary: Physics professor and family man Jason Dessen is abducted from everything he loves.

episodes.title: Trip of a Lifetime
episodes.summary: Jason wakes to a life that makes no sense - he doesn't have a family and he's created something extraordinary.

episodes.title: The Box
episodes.summary: Leighton and Amanda show Jason his groundbreaking invention. Daniela and Jason2 throw a dinner party.

episodes.title: The Corridor
episodes.summary: Jason and Amanda fight to stay alive in the dangerous Corridor. Jason2 makes some life changes and visits an old friend.

episodes.title: Worldless
episodes.summary: As they learn more about the Box, Jason and Amanda see alternate versions of their lives. Jason2 begins training a potential investor.

episodes.title: Superposition
episodes.summary: Daniela suspects something's not right with her husband. Jason and Amanda grow closer.

episodes.title: In the Fires of Dead Stars
episodes.summary: Jason and Amanda visit a breathtaking world. To hide the truth from Daniela, Jason2 takes desperate action.

episodes.title: Jupiter
episodes.summary: Panicked and cornered, Jason2 tells Daniela and Charlie they need to leave town immediately.

episodes.title: Entanglement
episodes.summary: Season finale. The Dessens' world comes crashing down.

episodes.title: A Quiet Life
episodes.summary: The Dessens receive an unwelcome visitor. Ryan finds Amanda. Leighton finds himself.

episodes.title: A Perfect World
episodes.summary: The search for a new home starts again. Amanda and Ryan set off on a quest.

episodes.title: Everything Beautiful, Everything Terrible
episodes.summary: Jason's fixation on the Box tests his marriage. Ryan and Amanda step into a world forever changed.

episodes.title: Stars, Hide Your Fires
episodes.summary: The Dessens reach their breaking point.
